title: Yummy Salted Algerian Carrots Tagine
description: A roasted, pillowy carrot tagine with a salty kick, perfect for a quick gluten‑free dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Toss carrots with olive oil, sea salt, cumin, coriander, paprika, and minced garlic until evenly coated.
Spread carrots in a single layer on the sheet and roast for 15 minutes.
Remove sheet and drizzle lemon juice over carrots, then return to oven for another 10 minutes.
While roasting, pour 1/4 cup water into a small saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer.
When carrots are tender, transfer them to a heavy skillet and add the simmering water.
Cover and let the carrots steam for 5 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Stir gently, then remove from heat and taste, adjusting salt if needed.
Serve hot as a side or over couscous for a complete meal.
